fixArrowOpen: Don't select all when the math editor opens via arrow keys
fixArrowOpenDesc: SiYuan selects the whole formula when the inline-math editor is opened with ← / →. Enable this to collapse the caret instead.
caretOnOpenDesc: With "Follow arrow key": pressing → (entering from the left) puts the caret at the start, pressing ← (entering from the right) puts it at the end.
fixClickOpen: Also deselect when opened by mouse click
fixClickOpenDesc: Off by default, so the original "click to select all and retype" behaviour is preserved.
enableCompletionDesc: Type plain English letters inside the formula editor (no leading \ needed) to get LaTeX command suggestions; ↑/↓ to choose, Enter to confirm.
completionInBlockMathDesc: Enable completion for $$…$$ math blocks as well as inline $…$ formulas.
minCharsDesc: How many letters must be typed before the suggestion list appears. Default: 1.
maxSuggestionsDesc: How many candidates to show at most. Default: 50.
fuzzyMatchDesc: Besides prefix/substring matching, allow subsequence (fuzzy) matching. Turn off for stricter results.
showPreviewDesc: Render each candidate with KaTeX inside the suggestion list.
enterAcceptsDesc: While the suggestion list is open, Enter inserts the selected command.
tabAcceptsDesc: While the suggestion list is open, Tab also inserts the selected command.
lastTabActionDesc: What happens when Tab is pressed while the caret is already inside the last brace.
